name: Shredded Chicken & White Rice Caldo (Mexican Chicken Soup)
whyItWorks: Rich chicken bone broth simmered with jasmine rice, shredded chicken breast, a pinch of cumin, and soft-cooked peeled carrots and diced peeled zucchini.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Top with cubed ripe avocado and skip raw onions, jalapenos, and lime peel extracts.
